purpose: Develop original frontend website art direction through game interface geometry, typography, scene relationships and interaction choreography.
interaction_priorities: Visible project-specific button containers with one readable label. Reserve arrows for a shared selection cursor, a direction or a real target. Omit decorative chevrons and underlined button labels.
One readable label per idea, with essential text at the point of use, including on phones
No ornamental slashes, padded section numbers, giant background words, tiny footer captions or decorative 3D lines
Artwork that can extend outside a stable control target
Distinct entry, settle, exit and interrupted behavior
Original keyboard, touch, responsive and reduced-motion states
